title: RocksDB table signature
summary: A RocksDB SSTable file has the magic 0x88E241B6 at the END of the file (last 8 bytes).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Magic 0x88E241B6 at the END of the file (last 8 bytes).
RocksDB is a fork of LevelDB with more features (column families, transactions, etc.).
RocksDB is used by CockroachDB, TiDB, and many other databases.
